title: Dreamwalker?
content: My one coworker and I discuss dreams regularly- he seems to be one of the only people in my actual life that gets what I’m talking about. I told him about this sub several times (esp. since I used to be an avid poster) and many of our conversations circle back to mallworld. Furthermore, we recently realized we’ve been having dreams in the same locations confirmed by detailed maps I’ve drawn and specific scenarios we’ve talked about. With his permission, I wanted to post one of his reoccurring dreams to see if anyone can relate. He often encounters what he calls “the dreamwalker” - the first encounter was at mallworld. Screenshots of his dream are included in post. Sound familiar to anyone?
